Container.Name: wittymediaserver
Container.Overview: Your own media server: films, TV, music, photos, books, DVD and Blu-ray menus, and games. Runs as nobody:users with a read-only root. Hardware transcoding with Intel, AMD or NVIDIA graphics: see docs/DOCKER-UNRAID.md. Open source under the AGPL-3.0-or-later.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The port to open in a browser.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The database, settings, artwork and logs. Keep it on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media, read-only. Add its folders as libraries in the app.

Config.Name: Intel or AMD graphics
Config.Description: For hardware transcoding. Remove it on a machine with neither.
